A.label: A · Native resolution + standard VAE
A.description: The unchanged v0.6.0 baseline: native-resolution generation and standard H3 video VAE decoding. Original prepared references.

L.label: L · Low resolution + Lanczos
L.description: Generate at approximately half width and height, decode with the standard H3 video VAE, then enlarge with fixed Lanczos. Original prepared references.

X.label: X · Low resolution + X2 VAE
X.description: Decode the same final low-resolution latent used by L with the floating-point X2 VAE. Original prepared references; no B32, decoder quantization or streaming optimization.

E.label: E · E34 reference reconstruction + X2
E.description: Reconstruct each prepared reference with E34, resize it back to its exact original prepared dimensions, then use the same RGB for Qwen and the standard reference VAE. Low-resolution generation and floating-point X2 output; no B32 residual.

D.label: D · E34 + B32 detail enhancer + X2
D.description: Add the B32 detail residual to E34 reference reconstruction at strength 1.0, resize back to the fixed prepared-reference dimensions, and pass the same enhanced RGB to Qwen and the standard reference VAE. Low-resolution generation and floating-point X2 output.

A-prime.label: A′ · Wider native-canvas control
A-prime.description: Calibration-only standard-VAE control: generate at 1408 × 768 and center-crop to 1366 × 768, compared with A’s 1376 × 768 canvas. No X2 or B32.
